jobs.occupation: Flight Instructor - sponsored CRI/SPA program - (Re)location DK, Aarhus
jobs.description: About the Position This role offers a unique opportunity to combine flight instruction with classroom-based theory teaching, creating a varied and rewarding workday where your expertise truly makes a difference. The position is full time at our flying base in Aarhus Airport. You can, as a flight instructor, expect to conduct teaching primarily in flying aboard the aircraft. Occasionally there will also be teaching in the classroom or in the simulator. When you start at Greybird as a student you have high expectations of the quality of the education. Those are expectations that you, as a flight instructor, will help fulfill. This is both an exciting and challenging task. The sponsorship If you are not already certified CRI/SPA we will sponsor the education you need. For that we expect that you have: ✅ EASA ATPL or CPL ✅ Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft ✅ Meets the requirements of EASA FCL for CRI/SPA ME or IRI MEP technical and academic knowledge The ability to work structured and high level of quality awareness Experience in working with people The will to educate in a constructive and professional way A cooperative and welcoming attitude Basic knowledge in IT Further more we offer: Set monthly pay according to qualification & seniority, pension and private healthcare. Predictable schedule Permanent base in Aarhus Airport Possibility to fly in most of Europe Individual and extensive introduction training Thorough and individualized onboarding Are you dedicated to training and developing the next generation of pilots? Do you want a varied and rewarding workday where your expertise truly makes a difference? If so, we look forward to hearing from you. All we need is your CV. For further information or if you have any clarifying questions, please contact CFI Kurt Rehmeier reh@greybird.dk or +45 27 23 64 27. By receivement of your CV we will invite you to a confidential, exploratory conversation , where you can share your skills and ambitions, and we can present the opportunities at Greybird. Location: HQ DK, Aarhus Airport (Free parking / Direct bus) About Greybird: GreyBird Pilot Academy educates commercial pilots. Since the school started in 2013 it has grown and is today the leading pilot academy in Denmark with bases in multiple places in Europe. At the moment GreyBird employ more than 40 full time employees in Denmark, Sweden, Spain and Finland.

_Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges involving electrical systems in a purpose-driven environment? Are you motivated by owning critical infrastructure, driving optimizations, and ensuring reliable performance? Then this might be the job for you.

At AGC Biologics, you’ll join a fast-growing biopharmaceutical company where quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. As an Electrical/Automation Technician in our Equipment Maintenance team, you’ll be a key contributor in maintaining and improving manufacturing and utility systems—directly supporting life-changing therapies for patients worldwide.

In this role, your work directly impacts our ability to deliver high-quality biopharmaceuticals on time—and positions you at the heart of a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your expertise helps power life-changing therapies.

**About The Team

**The Equipment Maintenance team in Engineering comprises 8 dedicated technicians with a strong focus on personal development, collaboration, and high professional standards. We operate with a flat structure where every contribution matters and decisions are made collaboratively. Our culture emphasizes ownership, continuous learning, and mutual support. We work closely together to maintain critical production equipment and promote a safe, innovative, and engaging work environment.

**About The Role

**As an Electrician in our Equipment Maintenance team, you will play a critical role within Engineering by ensuring the reliability and performance of all electrical systems that keep our biopharmaceutical production equipment running around the clock. You will take technical ownership of complex electrical systems and support automation tasks as needed. You will be the team’s key resource when it comes to troubleshooting critical alarms, executing preventive and corrective maintenance, and driving continuous improvements in our electrical infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead troubleshooting of electrical faults in production and utility equipment, including motors, control panels, and distribution systems

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on legacy and modern equipment, ensuring maximum uptime

• Use CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to plan, execute, and document work orders accurately and on time

• Ensure full GMP-compliant documentation for all maintenance activities

• Support commissioning of new electrical installations and upgrades

• Identify and implement optimizations to improve equipment performance, safety, and energy efficiency

• Participate in the on-call and shift rotation to support 24/7 production operations

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a hands-on technician with strong expertise in electrical systems, a structured approach to maintenance, and a commitment to high-quality standards.

**Ideally, You Must Have The Following Qualifications

**

• Completed education as an Industrial Electrician or equivalent (e.g., “Elektriker med erfaring fra industri eller procesanlæg”)

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in electrical troubleshooting and maintenance

• Strong understanding of industrial power systems, motor control, switchboards, and safety standards

• Practical knowledge of control panels, frequency converters, and field-level electrical components

• Familiarity with CMMS systems for maintenance planning and execution

• Experience working in structured, regulated environments—ideally within GMP or similar standards

• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team

The following qualifications will further strengthen your application, but are not essential:

• Familiarity with automation systems and PLC fault tracing (e.g., Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley)

• Basic understanding of HMI/SCADA systems and distributed control concepts

• Able to communicate effectively in both Danish and English

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Sameer Ahmed, Senior Manager, Equipment Maintenance, at **sameer.ahmed@agc.com

**Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

We're now looking for a Chief Product & Technology Officer to lead our next chapter.

One accountable leader for what we build, why we build it and how we release it.

The Role:

The role translates the company’s growth ambition into an AI-first portfolio built on a scalable, secure and coherent platform, and ensures that it reaches customers predictably and at a high quality bar. The CPTO is both the architect of the portfolio and its foremost ambassador, internally and externally.

You'll own product strategy, technology, architecture and release cadence across our full product portfolio, leading an international product and R&D organization globally.

Reports to Chief Executive Officer; member of the Executive Management Team.

Direct reporst - VP of Technology Engineering; VP Product Management.

📍 Copenhagen HQ preferred

• international role, approx. 40–50 travel days a year.

What You'll Drive:

• Scale Retail platform solution for global enterprise customers and lead our entry into the US market.

• Set the direction for our next-generation platform.

• Take AI from roadmap to recurring revenue, built into the core platform and delivered responsibly.

• Bring several legacy systems together into one coherent, secure cloud platform.

• Build a predictable release rhythm and a data-driven, AI-first engineering culture.

• Shape build, partner or buy decisions and lead product and technical due diligence.

Strategic Priorities:

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Software: Lead the modernisation of products that need a technology or product uplift, building future-proof platforms that support global expansion while keeping the depth customers rely on.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

Join Site MSAT and help improve the performance of established vaccine manufacturing processes.

We are looking for a Senior Bioprocess Engineer who will combine process understanding, manufacturing data and engineering insight to deliver measurable improvements in yield, cycle time, capacity and robustness across our Rabies and TBE processes at the BNK site.

**About The Role

**As our Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will drive process optimization and continuous improvement throughout the lifecycle of our vaccine processes.

You will use data, scientific understanding and engineering methods to identify performance gaps, understand sources of variability and translate opportunities into practical, sustainable changes. Working closely with

Manufacturing and technical functions, you will lead improvement initiatives from problem definition and analysis through testing, implementation and verification of benefits. Equipment knowledge will be important where equipment–process interactions affect performance, but the focus of the role is the process and its outcomes.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Analyse process performance using continued process verification data, statistics and data visualisation.

• Lead improvements in yield, cycle time, throughput, capacity and process robustness.

• Apply structured problem solving and Lean methods to identify root causes and resolve process challenges.

• Build process understanding through manufacturing data, scientific knowledge and shop-floor insights.

• Design engineering studies, trials and scale-down models to evaluate process improvements.

• Translate findings into recommendations, business cases and implementation plans with measurable outcomes.

• Implement and sustain improvements through risk assessment, change control, validation and updated control strategies.

• Provide technical expertise for complex deviations, investigations and CAPAs.

• Support technology transfer, scale-up, process introduction and requirements for equipment, automation and digital solutions.

• Collaborate across Manufacturing, technical and quality functions, Global MSAT and external partners.

**What You Bring

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biochemical, chemical, bioprocess, pharmaceutical engineering or a related discipline.

• Experience in process optimisation, manufacturing science, process engineering or continuous improvement within GMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing, preferably vaccines or biologics.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including manufacturing-data analysis, process trending and statistical methods.

• A proven ability to improve yield, cycle time, capacity, process robustness or cost efficiency.

• A solid understanding of bioprocess unit operations and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of GMP, validation, change control, investigations, risk management and data integrity.

• A collaborative, pragmatic approach and the ability to turn technical insights into clear recommendations and lead cross-functional improvements.

• Experience with downstream processing, Lean, bottleneck analysis, design of experiments, scale-down models, technology transfer or scale-up is an advantage.

Why join us?

You will join a collaborative Site MSAT team with the opportunity to shape how process optimisation is delivered for established vaccine products.

Your work will turn manufacturing data and process knowledge into tangible improvements that strengthen product quality, process capability and reliable supply.

The role offers meaningful technical ownership, close access to commercial operations and the freedom to combine scientific thinking with practical engineering solutions.

Your work will turn manufacturing data and process knowledge into tangible improvements that strengthen product quality, process capability and reliable supply.

The role offers meaningful technical ownership, close access to commercial operations and the freedom to combine scientific thinking with practical engineering solutions.

**Ready to help keep life-saving vaccines moving?

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about project management and delivering innovative solutions that align with business goals? Do you excel at leading cross-functional teams to successfully implement complex projects? If so, you might be the new Solutions Project Manager at Hempel.

**About The Job

**We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Solutions Project Manager to oversee the planning, development, and delivery of solutions that support business objectives and customer needs. This role requires a combination of project management expertise and strategic thinking to drive successful implementation across multiple stakeholders and teams.

You’ll collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and alignment on project goals. Your ability to manage risks, track performance, and drive continuous improvement will be key to delivering high-quality solutions.

**What You Can Look Forward To In This Role

**Reporting to Director for Marine Solution Management, you will play a critical role in delivering impactful solutions and optimizing project execution. Your expertise in project management will ensure successful planning and delivery of initiatives that enhance business performance.

**You Will Make An Impact By

**

• Developing and managing detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets for solution delivery.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to define solution requirements and oversee implementation.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for external customers and partners during the project lifecycle.

• Overseeing the testing, deployment, and integration of solutions into existing systems.

• Ensuring quality assurance processes are followed throughout the project.

• Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and solution effectiveness.

• Identifying areas for improvement in solution delivery processes and implementing best practices.

**To Thrive In This Role, You

**

• Have a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

• Have 5+ years of experience in project management, solution management, or a related role.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.

• Have proven ability to engage, influence, and manage expectations of diverse stakeholders, including technical teams, customers, and senior management.

• Have excellent communication skills, tailoring messaging to various stakeholders.

• Demonstrate the ability to plan, execute, monitor, and close projects effectively.

• Are adaptable, innovative, and customer-focused in your approach.

**Key Stakeholders

**

• Customers

• Sales Team

• R&D

• Business Development

• Solutions Management

• Product Management

• Services

• Commercial Excellence

• Marine Performance Advisory

**Global career possibilities

**At Hempel, we offer a variety of global career possibilities and many cross-functional and cross-cultural working relationships. We strive to create the right conditions for personal and professional development.

Join a global company where employees are truly passionate about delivering the best in everything they do. With business in mind and people at heart, we always work together to influence our road ahead. We want you to be part of our growth journey and of a great global family.

**Sounds like a match?

**Welcome to apply! Click the ‘Apply for position’ button in the top-right corner and submit your application letter with a CV in English via our recruitment system. Final deadline for applications is **27 November 2026.**Application due

2026-11-27

Seniority Level

Associate

Job Functions

Analyst, Business Development, Project Management

Chemicals

_At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

_At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities.

We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

**About the job

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Quality Engineer (m/f/d) within our global Quality Center of Expertise (COE) in Danfoss Sensing Solutions (SEN) you will contribute to shaping quality excellence in a rapidly growing business.

You will serve as a versatile contributor across customer, supplier, project and quality management areas. You will work closely with the local Quality teams in China, Europe and Mexico as well as with our Customer Quality Managers and report to the global head of SEN Quality COE.

At Danfoss, we believe quality is a key enabler of innovation and customer success. In this role, you'll help strengthen our global quality culture while supporting the growth of our Sensing Solutions business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Identify improvement opportunities through KPI monitoring, data analytics (incl. AI), process reviews, and internal/external benchmarking; foster sharing with other sites.

• Lead or support internal Quality Initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

• Participate in Supplier selection, monitoring, auditing and continuous development activities.

• Govern and maintain the global SEN Quality & EHS Management System incl. managing external 3rd Party Audits on ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

• Act as subject matter expert for systems & tools such as Q.wiki, APIS, SAP, One CRM, Power BI, PLM and provide guidance and coaching to employees.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience will also be considered.

• Advanced knowledge of quality management principles and quality core tools such as APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans and problem-solving methodologies.

• Self-driven, flexible, structured and persistent work style with the ability to manage multiple tasks in parallel.

• Strong ability to communicate factually and appropriately with all internal and external stakeholders, mainly in English.

• Skills such as risk and change management, coaching, team facilitation, also in difficult situations.

• Strong digital mindset with an affinity for data analytics, AI-enabled quality processes, and enterprise systems.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

• Build and operate the infrastructure for agentic AI workloads, including agent hosting, orchestration, and the platform capabilities needed to run them reliably at scale.

• Build toward a truly hybrid AI setup, pairing cloud-native AI capabilities with on-prem infrastructure so workloads can run wherever makes the most sense.

• Contribute to the guidance and standards coming out of the AI CoE, helping define what "good" looks like for agentic usage, credit and cost management, and agent scaling across the company.

• Strengthen and tune our Kubernetes workloads, making sure they run with the performance, resilience, and efficiency our business depends on.

• Drive a Platform Engineering approach to our cloud and AI infrastructure and tooling, working closely with Software Engineering teams and the AI CoE to build cohesive, developer-friendly experiences.

• Deliver on a modern, secure, and scalable cloud architecture, which you will help shape - one that's increasingly built with AI workloads in mind.

To succeed in this role, we are not just looking for someone who checks boxes - we're looking for someone honest, vocal, and unafraid to challenge the status quo when you see ways we can improve.

**Who are we looking for?

**So, if you enjoy spotting the glitches in the Matrix before anyone else does, or you’ve ever whispered "it's always DNS" to yourself (even when the culprit turned out to be a misbehaving agent), we consider that a positive sign.

Those qualities tend to go hand in hand with what we're looking for: someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working, and combines technical depth with a pragmatic mindset, helping us build and evolve the platform capabilities that support both today's cloud services and tomorrow's AI ambitions.

The skills that will help you thrive include:

• A solid grasp of the Azure Cloud ecosystem, understanding both its opportunities and its boundaries.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Bicep, and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and repeatability to how we build cloud resources.

• Comfort with scripting, whether your tool of choice is Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to automate tasks and streamline operational workflows.

• Experience with Kubernetes fundamentals, including deployments, services, and scaling.

• Curiosity about or exposure to AI infrastructure concepts - things like model hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, or GPU-backed workloads - even if you're not an AI expert yet.

• General familiarity with CI/CD and networking, giving you a well-rounded foundation for how we do cloud engineering.

**Welcome to Group IT

**When joining Group IT, you will be joining a digital transformation journey as we replace our legacy systems and transition towards a modular and flexible integrated setup. Group IT, a dynamic and rapidly evolving part of STARK Group, is responsible for delivering groupwide business-critical IT solutions. We strive to modernize and reimagine the IT landscape to ensure both scalability and composability to meet existing and future business needs, and we would like your help to rethink the way things are done in our industry to offer our customers a superior experience.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Magnus Bech Larsen, magnus.larsen@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

Director, Lab Consulting

About the role

NNIT is looking for a Director to lead our Lab Consulting team within the Digital Manufacturing division.

This is a senior leadership role for an experienced consulting leader with strong knowledge of life sciences, laboratory processes, lab digitalization and manufacturing IT. You will lead a team of consultants across Europe and take responsibility for developing our Lab Consulting business, strengthening delivery quality and building trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders.

You will work closely with the Digital Manufacturing leadership team and Advisory team to shape our services, support strategic customer engagements and contribute to continued growth in a highly regulated industry.

Your responsibilities:

Leadership and people development

• Lead, develop and grow the Lab Consulting team across Europe

• Set direction for the team and ensure alignment with business priorities and customer needs

• Build the right capabilities to support consulting delivery within life sciences and regulated manufacturing

• Coach and mentor consultants in consulting excellence, customer engagement and NNIT ways of working

• Manage performance, development plans and succession planning for team members

Some of the most critical applications in Danish banking run on technology that predates modern engineering practices. In the Reduce Legacy Tribe, you will help change that — applying AI, automation and thoughtful architecture to make modernisation faster, safer and repeatable. This is engineering work with real consequences, and you will see the results.

What you will be doing

You will join a collaborative squad working across teams to modernise business-critical web applications serving advisors, business customers and private customers. This is a practical software architecture role, not an Enterprise Architecture position.

You will analyse codebases, design migration patterns and develop reusable tooling with engineers, translating technical understanding into architecture decisions that guide day-to-day work. Working closely with development and delivery teams, you will shape solutions, discuss trade-offs and resolve implementation questions to make migration approaches workable.

Development teams retain ownership of implementation and delivery; your role is to help them turn complex modernisation challenges into practical solutions.

More specifically, you will:

• Analyse legacy code, dependencies and business flows to choose realistic migration strategies

• Design gradual replacements and rebuild where direct migration would carry complexity forward

• Develop reusable migration patterns, transition designs and developer tooling with teams

• Explore AI agents for analysis, component generation, testing and migration verification

• Reduce lead time through automated quality checks and safer, smaller deployments

About you

• Practical software engineering background, for example as a software architect, lead engineer or senior software engineer

• Strong understanding of end-to-end application design, including frontends, APIs, security, testing and observability

• Ability to read and understand an existing codebase and assess when to migrate, simplify or rebuild

• Clear communicator who can summarise complex topics and discuss trade-offs with engineers

• Understanding of AI-assisted development: how to guide agents, assess generated code and validate results

Experience with legacy modernisation, reusable migration tooling or our stack (React, .NET BFF services, Kubernetes, mainframe integration and GitHub Actions) is a plus. Comparable technologies are equally relevant, and we value the perspective you bring from different environments.

What we offer you

You will work primarily from our Aarhus or Copenhagen office, with the flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. You will tackle difficult engineering problems with visible results on applications used by thousands of customers, working alongside engineers who are genuinely curious about what AI can do for modernisation.

There is real room to grow your architectural thinking and broaden your experience with emerging development practices.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you are ready to take on complex engineering challenges and help shape the path forward for critical banking applications, we would be glad to hear from you. Reach out to hiring manager Ole Bang Fredsø Weigelt at owei@danskebank.dk if you have any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 1 December 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Portchain

Portchain exists to make maritime shipping more predictable, efficient, and green. We help shipping companies and terminals coordinate around shared, trustworthy information to reduce delays, fuel consumption, and emissions.

Our products support some of the world’s largest shipping companies, with more than 200 terminals connected through the Portchain Network.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

You’ll build services, APIs, and integrations that power carrier and terminal workflows, berth planning, and new products. Working closely with Product, you’ll turn customer problems into simple, scalable solutions and own your work from design through production.

Our stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud, with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.

How we work

Product teams of four or more engineers, each supported by a dedicated Product Manager, but with overlap between teams when needed.

We care about craftsmanship: understandable code, trustworthy high quality data, thoughtful user experiences, and systems that remain reliable and maintainable. We balance that care with pragmatic decisions and still deploy 10+ per day.

Curiosity matters here. We ask questions, explore customer problems, challenge assumptions, and learn from each other and from mistakes without blame.

How we use AI

AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. We use it for exploration, implementation, review, and technical sparring, and share useful practices with the team. We move faster than any of our customers, but not at the expense of quality or engineering understanding of behavior.

The final judgment remains with the engineer. We expect you to understand, review, validate, and be able to defend the code and decisions you ship, while protecting customer and company data.

What we’re looking for

• Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous execution, error handling, and diagnosing production issues.

• Strong relational database skills: schema design, SQL, transactions, and query performance. We use PostgreSQL.

• Experience designing robust APIs and integrating systems with different data formats and reliability characteristics.

• Experience deploying and operating software on GCP, AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform. We use GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL etc.)

• Sound architectural judgment, pride in your craft, and the ability to turn loosely defined problems into pragmatic solutions.

• Curiosity about unfamiliar domains and technologies, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to end-to-end ownership.

Useful extras include

GCP/Cloud Run, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, complex data ingestion, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience, and breadth across languages or technical side projects.

What we offer

• Meaningful work with global economic and environmental impact.

• Influence over products, architecture, and ways of working.

• Experienced, curious, and supportive colleagues.

• Competitive compensation and pension.

• Flexible working hours in our Copenhagen office.

• Subsidized lunch, snacks, and drinks.

• A dedicated development budget and support for continued learning.

If the role sounds exciting and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

Scope and authority

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

AI architecture

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

Governance and regulation

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

Team leadership

• Line management for four architects: coaching, performance, career development, hiring.

• Establish ways of working — review process, documentation standards, quality gates — and hold the team to them.

• Represent architecture in leadership forums, steering committees and cross-functional planning.

• Keep architects hands-on and embedded with engineering teams; architecture produced at a distance from delivery does not land.

What You Will Have Done By Month 12

• A published and adopted standard for what is built on Databricks, with evidence of designs changed by it.

• A clear model for data product alignment and ownership, applied on live work rather than documented in isolation.

• An architecture review forum running to a predictable cadence, with a visible ADR record and a known path for challenging a decision.

• Approved agentic and ML reference patterns in use.

• At least one legacy component fully decommissioned, not just superseded.

• A development plan in place for each of the four architects, and any open roles filled.

Essential Experience

• 5+ years designing and delivering production data platform solutions at enterprise scale, hands-on.

• At least 2 years line-managing technical specialists, including performance management, career development and hiring.

• Has held a design approval or architecture governance mandate, including declining designs and making that decision hold.

• Has led a platform migration or a parallel-run estate through to legacy decommission.

• Deep working knowledge of Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) as a target architecture, plus enough Azure Synapse (star schemas, conformed models, dedicated pools) to govern what remains there, and pipeline orchestration with ADF or Databricks Workflows.

• Has designed source-aligned, domain-aligned and consumer-aligned data products, with a clear view of where distributed domain ownership beats a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) and where it does not.

• Has implemented or governed a domain ownership model — data mesh or similar — including the federated governance and stewardship that makes it work.

• Has architected agentic and ML systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation and guardrails; feature and model lifecycle, serving, and monitoring for drift.

• Has set architecture standards that others adopted — solution patterns, reference architectures and architecture decision records.

• Has implemented data quality frameworks, data contracts or computational governance in production.

• Holds an architectural position under delivery pressure, and judges well when to concede.

• Communicates architecture clearly to technical and business audiences, including solution designs, ADRs and data flow diagrams.

• Understanding of retail, manufacturing, finance or supply chain business processes and how data flows through a business.

Desirable

• Familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and enterprise AI governance.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you interested in sustainability, enjoy working with data, and want to turn reporting requirements into practical action? Join Flatpay and help build the foundations of our ESG work across multiple markets!

We’re looking for a curious, structured colleague who enjoys digging into details, connecting with people, and bringing order to complex information.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,500 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**What You'll Do

**You’ll coordinate ESG data collection and reporting across our markets, working with internal teams, suppliers, and external compliance partners. From reviewing supplier documentation to improving reporting processes, you’ll help ensure we have reliable information and clear ways of working as we grow.

This is a hands-on role with international exposure and room to develop. You’ll help shape Flatpay’s ESG function from the ground up, taking increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow.

• Coordinate ESG reporting across markets. Organize data collection, follow up on inputs, and support accurate, timely reporting, including CSRD-related work where applicable.

• Build a reliable data foundation. Review compliance reports, product documentation, and supplier data sheets; identify gaps; and source the information needed for reporting.

• Work across teams and borders. Collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, and external compliance partners to make reporting processes clear and manageable.

• Track relevant requirements. Help assess what developments in CSRD, the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), and local producer responsibility schemes mean for Flatpay.

• Coordinate producer responsibility reporting. Work with Dansk Producentansvar (DPA), equivalent organisations in other markets, and relevant compliance partners.

• Support practical sustainability initiatives. Contribute to improvements in reverse logistics, refurbishment, and how we manage products throughout their lifecycle.

• Help establish our ESG function. Build processes, improve data quality, and gradually become an internal point of contact for sustainability reporting and compliance questions.

**Who You Are

**

• An interest in ESG and sustainability, particularly the data and reporting behind them.

• An analytical mindset and confidence working with spreadsheets and structured data.

• A careful, organised approach: you spot inconsistencies, ask questions, and follow through.

• The ability to work with colleagues and suppliers to get the information you need.

• Curiosity about regulations and the ability to translate complex information into clear next steps.

• Strong communication skills in English and an interest in working across international markets.

Previous exposure to ESG reporting, sustainability, compliance, or data analysis is a plus. This could come from a full-time role, student position or involvement in relevant project. Familiarity with CSRD or producer responsibility is welcome, but you don’t need to arrive as an expert in every framework.

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical ESG experience across multiple markets and see the direct impact of your work. Your ideas will help shape our processes, strengthen our reporting, and inform how we approach sustainability as we scale.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?
